local function create(className: string, props: {[string]: any}?): any
    local inst = Instance.new(className)
    if props then
        local parent = props.Parent
        for k, v in pairs(props) do
            if k ~= "Parent" then
                (inst :: any)[k] = v
            end
        end
        if parent then
            inst.Parent = parent
        end
    end
    return inst
end

local function corner(parent: Instance, radius: number): UICorner
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    c.Parent = parent
    return c
end

local function stroke(parent: Instance, color: Color3, thickness: number?): UIStroke
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = color
    s.Thickness = thickness or 1
    s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    s.Parent = parent
    return s
end

local function getGuiRoot(): Instance
    local ok, target = pcall(function()
        return (typeof(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if ok and target then
        local canParent = pcall(function()
            local t = Instance.new("Folder")
            t.Parent = target
            t:Destroy()
        end)
        if canParent then return target end
    end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local currentRecord: FailedRecord? = nil

local function updateUI()
    local safeTotal = math.max(1, state.totalInstances)
    local progress = math.clamp(state.processedInstances / safeTotal, 0, 1)
    local pct = math.floor(progress * 100)

    PercentText.Text = pct .. "%"
    CountText.Text = string.format("%d / %d assets", state.processedInstances, state.totalInstances)
    TabErrorsBtn.Text = string.format("Errors (%d)", #state.failed)
    TabErrorsBtn.TextColor3 = (#state.failed > 0) and THEME.Danger or THEME.TextMuted

    if state.isMinimized then
        TitleLabel.Text = pct .. "%"
    end

    TweenService:Create(ProgressBar, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0),
    }):Play()
end

local function retrySingleAsset(errRecord: FailedRecord, actionBtn: TextButton?, cardFrame: Frame?)
    if actionBtn then
        actionBtn.Text = "..."
        actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.TextMuted
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = os.clock()
        local targetToLoad: {Instance} = {}
        if errRecord.targetInstance and errRecord.targetInstance.Parent then
            table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.targetInstance)
        end

        local retrySucceeded = false
        local latestStatus = "Unknown"

        if #targetToLoad > 0 then
            ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(targetToLoad, function(_, status)
                latestStatus = tostring(status)
                if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                    retrySucceeded = true
                end
            end)
        else
            latestStatus = "Instance destroyed"
        end

        local elapsedMs = math.floor((os.clock() - startTime) * 1000)

        if retrySucceeded then
            if actionBtn then
                actionBtn.Text = string.format("OK %dms", elapsedMs)
                actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
            end
            if cardFrame then
                cardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SuccessBg
                local s = cardFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if s then
                    s.Color = THEME.Success
                end
            end

            task.delay(1.2, function()
                for i, item in ipairs(state.failed) do
                    if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
                        table.remove(state.failed, i)
                        break
                    end
                end
                state.failedSeen[errRecord.id] = nil
                state.recoveredCount += 1
                updateUI()
                if state.activeTab == "errors" then
                    renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
                elseif state.activeTab == "info" then
                    switchTab("errors")
                end
            end)
        else
            errRecord.retries += 1
            errRecord.reason = string.format("%s (attempt %d)", latestStatus, errRecord.retries + 1)
            if actionBtn then
                actionBtn.Text = "Fail"
                actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Danger
                task.delay(1.4, function()
                    actionBtn.Text = "Retry"
                    actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
                end)
            end
            if state.activeTab == "info" and currentRecord == errRecord then
                DiagStatus.Text = errRecord.reason
            end
            updateUI()
        end
    end)
end

function renderErrors(query: string?)

    end

    local count = 0

    for idx, err in ipairs(state.failed) do
        local matches = (q == "")
            or string.find(string.lower(err.name), q, 1, true)
            or string.find(string.lower(err.reason), q, 1, true)
            or string.find(string.lower(err.fullName), q, 1, true)

            })

                Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 22),
                BackgroundColor3 = THEME.BgCard,

        create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextColor3 = THEME.TextDim,
            Text = (q == "") and "No errors recorded." or "No assets match search.",
            Parent = ErrorScroll,
        })
    end
end

    state.activeTab = tab

    ErrorsPage.Visible = (tab == "errors")
    InfoPage.Visible = (tab == "info")

    TabMonitorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (tab == "monitor") and THEME.BgCard or THEME.BgMain
    TabMonitorBtn.BackgroundTransparency = (tab == "monitor") and 0 or 1
    TabMonitorBtn.TextColor3 = (tab == "monitor") and THEME.TextPrimary or THEME.TextMuted

    TabErrorsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (tab == "errors") and THEME.BgCard or THEME.BgMain
    TabErrorsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = (tab == "errors") and 0 or 1
    TabErrorsBtn.TextColor3 = (tab == "errors") and THEME.TextPrimary or THEME.TextMuted

RetryAllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if #state.failed == 0 then return end
    RetryAllBtn.Text = "Retrying..."

    task.spawn(function()
        local recovered = 0
        local toRetry: {Instance} = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(state.failed) do
            if item.targetInstance and item.targetInstance.Parent then
                table.insert(toRetry, item.targetInstance)
            end
        end

        if #toRetry > 0 then
            ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(toRetry, function(contentId, status)
                if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                    recovered += 1
                    for i = #state.failed, 1, -1 do
                        local f = state.failed[i]
                        if f.contentId == contentId or (f.targetInstance and f.targetInstance.Name == contentId) then
                            state.failedSeen[f.id] = nil
                            table.remove(state.failed, i)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        state.recoveredCount += recovered
        RetryAllBtn.Text = string.format("+%d", recovered)
        updateUI()
        renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
        task.delay(1.4, function() RetryAllBtn.Text = "Retry All" end)
    end)
end)

        isResizing = true

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
    if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        RootFrame.Position = UDim2.new(frameStart.X.Scale, frameStart.X.Offset + delta.X, frameStart.Y.Scale, frameStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    elseif isResizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local deltaX = input.Position.X - resizeStart.X
        local deltaY = input.Position.Y - resizeStart.Y
        local newW = math.clamp(startSize.X + deltaX, CONFIG.MinWidth, CONFIG.MaxWidth)
        local newH = math.clamp(startSize.Y + deltaY, CONFIG.MinHeight, CONFIG.MaxHeight)
        RootFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, newW, 0, newH)
    end
end)

local frameCount = 0
local lastSample = os.clock()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    frameCount += 1
    local now = os.clock()
    local dt = now - lastSample

    if dt >= 0.65 then
        local fps = math.floor(frameCount / dt)
        frameCount = 0
        lastSample = now

        ChipFps.Text = string.format("FPS %d", fps)
        ChipFps.TextColor3 = (fps >= 45 and THEME.TextMuted) or THEME.Danger

        local ok, ping = pcall(function()
            return math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
        end)
        if ok then
            ChipPing.Text = string.format("%dms", ping)
        end

        if state.isRunning and not state.isComplete then
            state.elapsedTime = os.clock() - state.startTime
            ChipTime.Text = formatClock(state.elapsedTime)

            local speed = (state.elapsedTime > 0) and (state.processedInstances / state.elapsedTime) or 0
            state.speed = speed
            ChipSpeed.Text = string.format("%.0f/s", speed)

            local remain = math.max(0, state.totalInstances - state.processedInstances)
            local eta = (speed > 0) and math.ceil(remain / speed) or 0
            ChipEta.Text = (eta > 0 and eta < 999) and string.format("ETA %ds", eta) or "ETA --"
        end
    end
end)

local assetQueue: {Instance} = {}
local isWorking = false

local function processBatch(batch: {Instance})
    if #batch == 0 then return end
    local leader = batch[1]
    if leader and leader.Parent then
        CurrentPath.Text = formatPath(leader)
        CurrentMeta.Text = string.format("Class: %s | Batch: %d (%d files)", getAssetType(leader), #batch, state.totalFiles)
    end

    ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(batch, function(contentId, fetchStatus)
        state.totalFiles += 1
        if fetchStatus ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
            local idKey = tostring(contentId)
            if not state.failedSeen[idKey] then
                state.failedSeen[idKey] = true
                local foundInst: Instance? = nil
                for _, cand in ipairs(batch) do
                    if cand:GetFullName() == contentId or cand.Name == contentId then
                        foundInst = cand
                        break
                    end
                end
                local finalInst = foundInst or leader

                table.insert(state.failed, {
                    id = idKey,
                    name = finalInst and finalInst.Name or tostring(contentId),
                    fullName = finalInst and finalInst:GetFullName() or tostring(contentId),
                    assetType = finalInst and getAssetType(finalInst) or "Asset",
                    contentId = tostring(contentId),
                    targetInstance = finalInst,
                    reason = tostring(fetchStatus),
                    retries = 0,
                })
            end
        end
    end)

    state.processedInstances += #batch
    updateUI()
end

local function runWorker()
    if isWorking then return end
    isWorking = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while #assetQueue > 0 do
            local batch: {Instance} = {}
            for _ = 1, math.min(CONFIG.BatchSize, #assetQueue) do
                local item = table.remove(assetQueue, 1)
                if item then
                    table.insert(batch, item)
                end
            end
            if #batch > 0 then
                processBatch(batch)
            end
            task.wait()
        end

        isWorking = false

        if state.processedInstances >= state.totalInstances and not state.isComplete then
            state.isComplete = true
            state.isRunning = false
            StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Success
            CurrentPath.Text = "ALL ASSETS VERIFIED"
            CurrentMeta.Text = string.format("Done in %s (%d files, %d failed)", formatClock(state.elapsedTime), state.totalFiles, #state.failed)
            ChipEta.Text = "DONE"
            updateUI()
            if state.activeTab == "errors" then
                renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function enqueue(items: {Instance})
    local added = 0
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        local id = item:GetFullName()
        if not _G.TrackerLoadedAssetIds[id] then
            _G.TrackerLoadedAssetIds[id] = true
            table.insert(assetQueue, item)
            added += 1
        end
    end

    if added > 0 then
        state.totalInstances += added
        state.isComplete = false
        StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Accent
        updateUI()
        runWorker()
    end
end

local pendingStream: {Instance} = {}
local streamDebounce: thread? = nil

local function onDescendant(inst: Instance)
    if isTrackable(inst) then
        table.insert(pendingStream, inst)
        if not streamDebounce then
            streamDebounce = task.delay(1.2, function()
                local toAdd = pendingStream
                pendingStream = {}
                streamDebounce = nil
                enqueue(toAdd)
            end)
        end
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDescendant)
ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDescendant)
local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
if pGui then
    pGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDescendant)
end

local function bootstrap()
    state.startTime = os.clock()
    state.isRunning = true
    CurrentPath.Text = "INDEXING DOMAIN ROOTS..."

    local roots: {Instance?} = {
        workspace, ReplicatedStorage, ReplicatedFirst, Lighting,
        MaterialService, SoundService, StarterPack, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    }

    local found: {Instance} = {}
    local seen = {}

    for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
        if r then
            for _, d in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
                if isTrackable(d) and not seen[d] then
                    seen[d] = true
                    table.insert(found, d)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if #found == 0 then
        state.isComplete = true
        state.isRunning = false
        StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Success
        CurrentPath.Text = "NO ASSETS TO LOAD"
        CurrentMeta.Text = "0 items in memory"
        updateUI()
        return
    end

    enqueue(found)
end

bootstrap()
